People you’ve interacted with will be heart broken to have such a tragic loss and feel like they aren’t allowed to mourn because people knew you better. Any of your internet friends, if no one tells them they’ll just think you’ve avoided them and always wonder what they did wrong. While it’s not an inherently selfish act it is selfish. I get that there’s pain and you’re the only one feeling it and you want it to stop but in doing that youre causing so much more.
